historical_incident: Cloudflare Global Outage / Bot Management Feature Update
incident_summary: At approximately 06:05 UTC on November 2, 2020, Cloudflare experienced an outage across numerous data centers when an update to the Bot Management feature dataset caused the core proxy daemon to crash globally, leading to 502 Bad Gateway errors for web traffic.

root_cause.mechanism: ClickHouse metadata query emitted duplicate feature records due to uncompleted background merges in ReplacingMergeTree. The feature generation script did not deduplicate records and generated a feature file with duplicate entries. The edge proxy had an internal fixed-size array limit for features. When edge proxies downloaded and parsed the feature file, the number of features exceeded the array bounds, causing an unhandled panic/crash in the core proxy daemon on the main thread.
root_cause.trigger: ClickHouse table partition merge timing resulted in duplicate rows returned by the feature generator query.
root_cause.vulnerability: Hardcoded maximum feature capacity limit in the edge proxy without upstream validation, canary rollout, or process isolation.

actual_causal_sequence: Step 1: Background merges in ClickHouse ReplacingMergeTree had not completed for recent partitions.
Step 2: Scheduled feature generation job queried ClickHouse without FINAL or explicit deduplication.
Step 3: Query returned duplicate rows for certain feature definitions.
Step 4: Feature generator serialized the duplicate rows into the production bot management feature file.
Step 5: Feature file was published to Quicksilver and propagated globally within seconds.
Step 6: Edge proxy daemon parsed the feature file into memory.
Step 7: Duplicate feature entries caused total entry count to exceed the proxy's bounded array limit.
Step 8: Buffer overflow / array bounds violation caused the core proxy process (FL) to panic and terminate.
Step 9: Customer web requests routed through affected edge servers received 502/503 errors.
impact: Global service degradation and 502 Bad Gateway errors across dozens of edge data centers for approximately 25-30 minutes.
remediation: Emergency rollback of the malformed feature file in Quicksilver.
Updated feature extraction query with explicit deduplication logic to ignore unmerged duplicates.
Added automated schema and bounds validation checks prior to publishing files to Quicksilver.
Modified edge proxy parser to fail gracefully (reject invalid config and keep existing rules) rather than crashing the proxy daemon.
